_comment: Pin for the pagespeed-optimizer release the serving pair ships with.
tag: the optimizer release tag on the optimizer repository (optimizer-v<upstream>);
it must equal optimizer-v + this release's upstream version (module-only
reships drop the +rN tail and keep depending on the GA pair).
mps2_commit: the optimizer-repo commit that release was built from (provenance).
sha256sums_sha256: sha256 of that release's SHA256SUMS file; the fetch job
verifies the manifest against this hash and every artifact against the
manifest. Update this file as part of cutting each train: cut the
optimizer release FIRST, record the pin, then cut the module release.
A PLACEHOLDER tag makes the release lane refuse loudly.
